title: Batman Begins
creator: Christopher Nolan[ Director ] and David S. Goyer[ Writer ]
ov: Batman Begins is not merely the story of a man becoming a hero; it is the story of a man confronting his own demons and turning his greatest fear into his greatest weapon. In a city where corruption has become ordinary and justice has lost its meaning, Bruce Wayne creates an identity that exists between fear and hope. But beneath the mask lies a constant struggle between vengeance, morality and the responsibility that comes with power.

title: Fight Club
creator: David Fincher[Director] and Chuck Palahniuk[Writer]
ov: Fight Club is a journey into the fractured human mind, where dissatisfaction with life turns into rebellion against everything society teaches us to value. Through violence, chaos and an increasingly unstable sense of identity, it questions whether we truly control our lives or are simply prisoners of the identities we've constructed for ourselves.

title: Salaar
creator: Prashanth Neel
ov: It have one of the crazy world building in recent indian films, it has good drama and action in a good balance. it is a perfect fan movie that remains with in hearts for long time.
